subject: Confidential pilot funding and evidence plan — Caduceus VPC POC
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <pri@caduceushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential pilot funding request / SOC2 evidence

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security and privacy teams want to run a Private (VPC) pilot to validate integrations with our EHR ingestion pipeline. Two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood provide promotional trial credits to cover the first 3 weeks of GPU usage for the pilot, and 2) can you share high-level SOC2 evidence and a network segmentation diagram we can present to procurement?

The pilot will ingest de-identified clinical summaries but our legal team still needs the assurance. If credits require any additional paperwork, please let us know so we can move quickly — we are targeting a mid-June internal review.

Thanks,
Priya
Priyanka Shah
Dir. of Platform Integrations
Caduceus Health
attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pri@caduceushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential pilot funding request / SOC2 evidence

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can support a short-term promotional credit package to cover the initial pilot window, contingent on a couple of controls and an evidence exchange:

- Credits: up to $12k of pilot credits (covers ~3 weeks on a small Private pool).
- Controls: VPC-only egress, customer-managed KMS for keys, and agreed data retention/auto-delete after the pilot.
- Evidence we can share immediately: a high-level SOC2 summary, network segmentation diagram, and our Private deployment MOU template.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Karthik for approvals on the credit terms and Neha from security to attach the SOC2 summary and diagram. If you can send the procurement contact and any PO requirements, we’ll align the paperwork.

Would a June 14 start date work for you?

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priyanka Shah <pri@caduceushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential pilot funding request / SOC2 evidence

Thanks — quick internal note. Approving promotional credits needs sales-ops signoff and a 30-day clawback window in our MOU for any post-pilot overages. Also want to limit the pilot to a single region (us-west) and cap max instance types to the small Private pool SKU.

Logan: please confirm you can accept those constraints in the MOU. Neha: please attach the SOC2 summary + network diagram (redacted) we can share with procurement. Priya: I’ll need the procurement contact and any CO terms you expect so revenue ops can draft the credit memo.

Karthik
VP, Solutions & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <pri@caduceushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential pilot funding request / SOC2 evidence

Hi Priya —

Attaching a redacted SOC2 high-level summary and a simplified network segmentation diagram that outlines our Private deployment controls. Notes:
- The SOC2 summary strips identifying customer receipts; full report available under NDA.
- Private deployment options support customer-managed KMS and VPC peering; we recommend restricting egress to your allowed IP ranges.
- Data retention: recommend auto-delete after 30 days post-pilot unless you request an extension in writing.

Attachments: SOC2-highlevel-summary.pdf (summary), network-segmentation-diagram.png (diagram), redwood-poc-ua-mou.docx (MOU template)

I can join a short security sync if you want to validate the controls with your InfoSec team — propose Thu 6/10 11am PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Priyanka Shah <pri@caduceushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential pilot funding request / SOC2 evidence

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. I reviewed the SOC2 summary with procurement — they want the MOU updated to include the 30-day auto-delete and the KMS requirement you mentioned, and procurement would like the pilot credit memo in a line-item format for their internal approvals.

We can target June 14 start, but small ask: can you extend the pilot credits to cover an extra 7 days in case we need to rerun a de-identification pass (so total ~4 weeks)? Procurement says that buffer makes approval smoother.

If you can send an updated MOU and the line-item credit memo by EOD tomorrow, I’ll present it to procurement on Friday morning. We are excited to move forward.

Regards,
Priya
Dir. of Platform Integrations
Caduceus Health
